paras.en: To study the population growth the calculation of general fertility rate and specific fertility rate are not sufficient because in their calculation two important factors i.e. the sex of the newly born children and their mortality are ignored. These two factors are taken into account in the calculation of reproduction rates.
paras.ur: آبادی میں اضافے کا مطالعہ کرنے کے لیے عمومی شرحِ زرخیزی اور مخصوص شرحِ زرخیزی کا حساب کافی نہیں کیونکہ ان کے حساب میں دو اہم عوامل یعنی نوزائیدہ بچوں کی جنس اور ان کی اموات نظر انداز کی جاتی ہیں۔ یہ دونوں عوامل شرحیں تولید کے حساب میں شامل کیے جاتے ہیں۔

i. ناخالصه د بیا زېږون کچه

paras.en: Gross reproduction rate consider only the factor of sex and hence over estimates the next generation because it omits the mortality of newly born female infants till they attain their maximum child bearing age. The other factors like migration, divorce unmarried women do affect the reproduction rate but are negligible as compared to the extent of mortality. The gross reproduction rate estimates the average number of female babies produced by one married women throughout her reproduction life.
